speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned a new movement disorder, but you haven't described the specific movements yet. Could you tell me exactly what involuntary movements or stiffness you are experiencing?

text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent start on risperidone and these symptoms of inner restlessness and pacing, this sounds like akathisia, a common side effect of antipsychotics.
